Renderings: 4-אנקי-וסדר-העולם (project glossary)

Binding for this project on top of the corpus renderings (../renderings.md, §0–§7). Translators add rows here at the first occurrence of each recurring term.

Lemmas: ETCSL's TEI lemmas and ORACC Q000334 (citation form, morph). "Lines" = ETCSL labels. Hebrew as in the > lines (plene; niqqud where the line has it). Rows marked ★ bind the translator of 1–249 (formulas and names that recur across the whole text).
